after5_farewell_seo_low.name: Seoyeon
after5_farewell_seo_low.text: *In the hallway, where the afternoon shadows have grown long, I run into Seoyeon. She pauses, then gives a short nod without meeting my eyes.* I know which way your heart went. ...There's nothing else I'd say to hold you here.

after5_farewell_yuna_low.name: Yuna
after5_farewell_yuna_low.text: *In the hall in front of the library, my eyes meet Yuna's. She holds the book she was reading tight against her chest and gives a quiet nod.* ...Bye.

after5_farewell_dain_low.name: Dain
after5_farewell_dain_low.text: *Dain, walking up the path in front of the gym, stops dead two steps away.* I know who you picked. I'll go in first and finish practice.

after5_farewell_seo_1.name: {name}
after5_farewell_seo_1.text: *By the hallway windows, as the festival's last event winds down, I run into Seoyeon, coming out alone after sorting papers.*

after5_farewell_seo_2.name: Seoyeon
after5_farewell_seo_2.text: At a moment like this, what face do you want from me, and what am I supposed to say? ...No. Forget it. This isn't yours to answer. *Seoyeon looks out the window and lets out a long breath.*

after5_farewell_seo_3.name: Seoyeon
after5_farewell_seo_3.text: I thought about pretending I didn't see you and just walking past. Running away like that sits even worse with me. I already know the choice you made. *She neatly tucks the hair that slipped down behind her ear and adjusts her grip on the bag strap.*

after5_farewell_seo_4.name: Seoyeon
after5_farewell_seo_4.text: Well, I expected it. I just don't want it to look like I was the one who gave up first.

after5_farewell_seo_6.name: Seoyeon
after5_farewell_seo_6.text: If that's your decision, I'll respect it. That doesn't mean I've sorted out my own feelings.

after5_farewell_seo_6_b.name: Seoyeon
after5_farewell_seo_6_b.text: *Seoyeon never looks back. She only lifts a hand to shoulder height and waves once. The wrist ribbon that caught the evening light slowly recedes down the hall.*

after5_farewell_seo_7.name: {name}
after5_farewell_seo_7.text: *Left alone in the empty hallway, I can't take a step. From the top of the stairs overhead, the distant clack of the rooftop door locking drifts down.*

after5_farewell_yuna_1.name: {name}
after5_farewell_yuna_1.text: *As I pass the library, Yuna, waiting by the door, comes up without a sound and places a thin book in my hand.*

after5_farewell_yuna_2.name: {name}
after5_farewell_yuna_2.text: *When I open the cover, a familiar pale lavender bookmark is tucked in neatly. A short line pressed in with a fountain pen catches my eye.*

after5_farewell_yuna_3.name: Yuna
after5_farewell_yuna_3.text: Don't be late for the person you chose. ...I still like you, though.

after5_farewell_yuna_4.name: Yuna
after5_farewell_yuna_4.text: *Without waiting for my answer, Yuna quietly turns toward the hall inside the library. The steady sound of her shoes fades past the corner.*

after5_farewell_yuna_5.name: Yuna
after5_farewell_yuna_5.text: *Where Yuna's presence has gone, I look down again at the line on the bookmark in my hand. Under the last character, the pale lavender ink has spread in a soft round blot, as if it soaked up moisture.* ...It was really fun, you reading my story.

after5_farewell_yuna_5b.name: {name}
after5_farewell_yuna_5b.text: *I walked quietly out into the hall, the book held to my chest.*

after5_farewell_dain_1.name: {name}
after5_farewell_dain_1.text: *Dain comes out from the gym entrance. Her stride is unusually short and slow, nothing like the way she always used to stride on ahead.*

after5_farewell_dain_2.name: Dain
after5_farewell_dain_2.text: Tch, that stings! But I'm not backing off just because I'm disappointed.

after5_farewell_dain_4.name: Dain
after5_farewell_dain_4.text: I know who you chose. I still like you, though. I'm allowed to say that much.

after5_farewell_dain_4_b.name: {name}
after5_farewell_dain_4_b.text: *Dain taps my shoulder with a loosely closed fist. There's less strength in it than usual.*

after5_farewell_dain_4_c.name: Dain
after5_farewell_dain_4_c.text: Treat her right. If you don't, I'm winning you back.

after5_farewell_dain_4_d.name: Dain
after5_farewell_dain_4_d.text: ...Okay, go. I'll only send you off smiling up to here. I don't have to act tough and hold in tears in front of you, too. *Dain turns, shoves the volleyball into the storage bin with a thud, and reties the strap of her knee brace hard.*

after5_farewell_dain_5.name: {name}
after5_farewell_dain_5.text: *With trembling fingertips, Dain presses the Velcro on her knee brace down once more, then walks into the gym without looking back.*

after5_farewell_dain_5b.name: {name}
after5_farewell_dain_5b.text: *I rubbed at the weight in my chest, left the front of the gym, and headed for the back of the school.*

after5_hidden_farewell_1.name: {name}
after5_hidden_farewell_1.text: *In front of the school gate, as the afternoon sun slants lower. Seoyeon is checking the last event roster with Haeun, Dain has slowed her stride with a volleyball tucked under one arm, and Yuna has stopped, eyes lowered to an open page. Soon the three quietly scatter down different paths.*

after5_hidden_farewell_3.name: {name}
after5_hidden_farewell_3.text: *At the gate, I raised a hand once, without a sound, toward the three backs moving away.*

after5_hidden_farewell_3b.name: {name}
after5_hidden_farewell_3b.text: *I turned and walked toward the back of the school, where a promise was waiting.*

after5_sunset_1.name: {name}
after5_sunset_1.text: *Over the school grounds, where a red sunset has settled long and low, the last announcement marking the end of the festival drifts out, faint.*

after5_hidden_route_choice_check.name: {name}
after5_hidden_route_choice_check.text: *In front of the sunset-stained gate, the path to the park where I promised to meet my friends and the path of staying at school to help finish the cleanup split right in front of me.*

after5_hidden_route_choice.name: {name}
after5_hidden_route_choice.text: *The tree-lined path toward the park and the hall back to the classroom building split. Before the sun is fully down, I have to decide who my heart answers today.*
choices: Go to the park and finish what we started
Return to the homeroom teacher and organize the literature-club manuscript
Return to the school nurse and organize the counseling records

after5_last_chance_1.name: {name}
after5_last_chance_1.text: *With a crackling final tone, the speakers across the school grounds cut out completely. I stop in the middle of the fork, where the sunset light lies thick.*

after5_last_chance_2.name: {name}
after5_last_chance_2.text: *I fidget with the phone in my pocket, then take it out. Across the black screen, still dark, only the festival banner swaying in the evening wind wavers.*

after5_last_chance_2_b.name: {name}
after5_last_chance_2_b.text: *In the end I slide the phone deep back into my pocket without turning the screen on. So I won't lose the back about to walk away, I take two long steps to the far side of the fork and call out the name at the top of my voice.*

after5_last_chance_2_d.name: Seoyeon
after5_last_chance_2_d.text: *Seoyeon stops and turns fully toward me. Behind her, the festival banner dyed red flaps once, hard, in the evening wind.*

after5_last_chance_2_f.name: {name}
after5_last_chance_2_f.text: *Seoyeon winds the end of the student council ribbon at her chest tight around one slender finger, then slowly lets it go.*

after5_last_chance_2_g.name: Seoyeon
after5_last_chance_2_g.text: Hold still. I'll talk first this time, so just stay like that for a moment.

after5_last_chance_2_h.name: {name}
after5_last_chance_2_h.text: *Seoyeon takes one step closer and quietly holds out her right hand in the sunset light.*

after5_last_chance_2_j.name: Seoyeon
after5_last_chance_2_j.text: If you're still not going to take it, say so here, straight. Don't leave me waiting again, hoping on my own like a fool. *Without pulling back her faintly trembling palm, Seoyeon looks straight up into my eyes.*

after5_last_chance_seo_low_2.name: Seoyeon
after5_last_chance_seo_low_2.text: *Seoyeon turns only her head, halfway, to look at me. The toe of her shoe still points toward the gate exit.* ...Why'd you call.

after5_last_chance_2_l.name: Dain
after5_last_chance_2_l.text: *Dain takes one more step on momentum, then pins the rolling volleyball under her sneaker and stops.*

after5_last_chance_2_n.name: Dain
after5_last_chance_2_n.text: {name}, just stand there a second. *Dain lets the arm holding the ball drop, the strength gone from it, and slowly turns toward me.*

after5_last_chance_2_p.name: {name}
after5_last_chance_2_p.text: Yeah. If I let you go like this, I think I'd regret it my whole life. I couldn't keep the words I need to say in front of you locked in my head. *Dain bites her lower lip hard and draws in a short, shaking breath.*

after5_last_chance_2_q.name: Dain
after5_last_chance_2_q.text: I'll say this first. I can't smile wide for you right now, the way I usually do. ...But I'll hear, all the way through, whatever you ran here to say.

after5_last_chance_2_r.name: {name}
after5_last_chance_2_r.text: I went over it dozens of times on the way, but the second I see your eyes I'm out of breath and the words won't come. ...Just wait a little. *Dain wipes the reddened corner of her eye with the back of her hand, and a clear wetness spreads over her fair skin.*

after5_last_chance_2_s.name: Dain
after5_last_chance_2_s.text: Say it. I'm not going anywhere. I'll hear all of it right here.

after5_last_chance_dain_low_2.name: Dain
after5_last_chance_dain_low_2.text: *Dain, who had walked one step past, slowly turns back. She holds the volleyball to her chest like a shield and doesn't close the distance.* ...Why.

after5_last_chance_yuna_2.name: Yuna
after5_last_chance_yuna_2.text: *The steady sound of shoes moving away takes two more steps, then cuts off. Yuna pulls the book in her arms in closer, and after two long breaths she slowly turns her head.*

after5_last_chance_yuna_4.name: {name}
after5_last_chance_yuna_4.text: I won't put it off any longer. I'll say it right here. ...Just listen for a second. *Two steps off, where the sunset has settled, Yuna waits, looking at me without a word.*

after5_last_chance_yuna_5.name: Yuna
after5_last_chance_yuna_5.text: I'll hear everything you have to say, then go. ...Even if I can't say I'm fine right now.

after5_last_chance_yuna_6.name: {name}
after5_last_chance_yuna_6.text: *Yuna meets my eyes without wavering. Before I noticed, the space between us has closed to little more than half a step.*

after5_last_chance_yuna_low_2.name: Yuna
after5_last_chance_yuna_low_2.text: *Yuna stops and looks back. Strength goes into the slender arms wrapped around her book, on guard.* ...Why.

after5_last_chance_choice.name: {name}
after5_last_chance_choice.text: *Looking straight into eyes where the sunset has settled deep, I choose the last words that have risen all the way to my throat.*
choices: Let us both take some time to think.

after5_confess_yes.name: {name}
after5_confess_yes.text: *I pull a deep breath in over the short ones and call the name in the clearest voice in the world.*

after5_confess_yes_2.name: {name}
after5_confess_yes_2.text: I like you. Enough that I don't want us to stay just close friends. I'm way too late, but this, at least, I wanted to say myself.

after5_confess_react_seo.name: Seoyeon
after5_confess_react_seo.text: *Seoyeon's long lashes tremble. Then, cheeks flushed, she steps up beside me and starts toward the park.* ...That was really mean, saying it this late. Still... now I finally know how you really feel.

after5_confess_react_seo_low.name: Seoyeon
after5_confess_react_seo_low.text: *Seoyeon says nothing until the crosswalk light in front of the school changes from green to red.* ...I heard what you just said. But today, leave it there.

after5_confess_react_dain.name: Dain
after5_confess_react_dain.text: *Stepping out the school gate, Dain stares down at her shoelaces, as if they could hide her flushed face.* ...Hey, you idiot. I waited all four days for that to come out of your mouth. No take-backs now!

after5_confess_react_dain_low.name: Dain
after5_confess_react_dain_low.text: *Dain slowly traces a black groove in the volleyball's leather with her thumb.* ...I heard the confession. Sorry, though. I don't think I can smile and answer you right now.

after5_confess_react_yuna.name: Yuna
after5_confess_react_yuna.text: *Yuna quietly starts walking, matching her steps beside my shadow.* ...Yeah. I heard every word you just said. Didn't miss one.

after5_confess_react_yuna_b.name: Yuna
after5_confess_react_yuna_b.text: Hearing you say it out loud like this... I don't have to be scared anymore that I misread how you feel, all on my own. *Yuna starts to loosen her hold on the book, then takes the corner again, careful with it.*

after5_confess_react_yuna_c.name: Yuna
after5_confess_react_yuna_c.text: I wanted to hear it in your voice. Not as words on paper.

after5_confess_react_yuna_d.name: Yuna
after5_confess_react_yuna_d.text: *Yuna takes a small folded note from deep in her uniform pocket and sets it on my palm. When I open it carefully, a single line in pale lavender fountain pen appears.*

after5_confess_react_yuna_f.name: {name}
after5_confess_react_yuna_f.text: *The last character is pressed deep, as if the fountain pen tip stayed there a long time. The square of paper still holds the soft creases of being folded and unfolded over and over in a pocket.*

after5_confess_react_yuna_g.name: Yuna
after5_confess_react_yuna_g.text: *She hides a reddened earlobe behind her hair and whispers.* ...If you read it all the way through, that's enough.

after5_confess_react_yuna_h.name: {name}
after5_confess_react_yuna_h.text: *We walked side by side, close enough that the backs of our hands almost brushed. Even without adding any words, the evening air went warm and sweet.*

after5_confess_react_yuna_i.name: {name}
after5_confess_react_yuna_i.text: *We walked out through the school gate, dragging our long shadows side by side.*

after5_confess_react_yuna_low.name: Yuna
after5_confess_react_yuna_low.text: *Yuna clutches the book in her arms until her hands go white.* ...I heard how you feel. But I can't give you my answer right now.

after5_confess_fail_walk_1.name: {name}
after5_confess_fail_walk_1.text: *The red sun sinks heavier below the horizon. We keep walking the same way, an awkward gap between us.*

after5_confess_fail_walk_2.name: {name}
after5_confess_fail_walk_2.text: *In the end, without an answer that fit, we walked toward the park under the evening dusk.*

after5_confess_no.name: {name}
after5_confess_no.text: *I can't bring myself to part my lips. I only turn off the phone screen and keep my mouth shut.*

after5_confess_no_2.name: {name}
after5_confess_no_2.text: *In the cooler evening wind, a festival flyer someone dropped rolls, crumpled, to my feet. I bend, pick the paper up, and quietly tuck it under the empty bulletin board.*

after5_confess_no_2b.name: {name}
after5_confess_no_2b.text: *I buried the name I never managed to call, turned around alone, and headed home.*

after5_set_harem.name: {name}
after5_set_harem.text: *I look for a long time at the three names pinned side by side at the top of the messenger. After hesitating, I message all three, asking to meet briefly behind the school.*

after5_harem_commit.name: {name}
after5_harem_commit.text: I'm sorry... In the end I couldn't choose only one of you. *In front of the three, who walked up one by one and stopped, I put my phone in my pocket. In the air gone cold, no one is quick to speak.*

after5_harem_walk_1.name: {name}
after5_harem_walk_1.text: *We leave that spot and walk together toward the park. While the streetlights come on one by one, no one breaks the silence first.*

after5_harem_walk_2.name: {name}
after5_harem_walk_2.text: *The old messages I never answered in time sit frozen on the lock screen. My heavy steps turned toward the entrance of the evening park.*

after5_defer_seo.name: Seoyeon
after5_defer_seo.text: *She slowly lowers her open hand.* Fine. If that is what you decided.

after5_defer_dain.name: Dain
after5_defer_dain.text: *She hugs the volleyball again.* Okay. We are stopping here again today.

after5_defer_yuna.name: Yuna
after5_defer_yuna.text: *She gathers the book back to her chest.* I see. We are stopping here again today.

after5_co_start.name: {name}
after5_co_start.text: *In the after-school hall, the festival crowd gone, the people from this morning's suffocating face-to-face are gathered again.*

after5_co_seo_1.name: Seoyeon
after5_co_seo_1.text: *Seoyeon starts to adjust her glasses, then quietly lowers her hand.* I already sent the student council closing schedule around to the members.

after5_co_seo_2.name: Seoyeon
after5_co_seo_2.text: I have nothing more to say to you today. Just go.

after5_co_yuna_1.name: Yuna
after5_co_yuna_1.text: *Yuna pulls the bookmark from her notebook and puts it deep in her bag.* I left every spot on the literature club board empty.

after5_co_dain_1.name: Dain
after5_co_dain_1.text: *Dain shoves the volleyball into the deepest corner of the storage bin.* I took your name off the afternoon event partner list.

after5_co_dain_2.name: Dain
after5_co_dain_2.text: Take care. Smiling at your face right now feels a little off.

after5_co_teacher_1.name: Homeroom Teacher
after5_co_teacher_1.text: *The homeroom teacher closes the attendance book without a sound.* I already handed the afternoon event wrap-up to a teacher from another class.

after5_co_teacher_2.name: Homeroom Teacher
after5_co_teacher_2.text: Let's set a proper time again next week for the personal talk. Today I'll finish clearing up the class event first.

after5_co_nurse_1.name: School Nurse
after5_co_nurse_1.text: *The school nurse puts the medical chart in a drawer and closes it.* We'll stop today's counseling here.

after5_co_nurse_2.name: School Nurse
after5_co_nurse_2.text: If you feel unwell, come to the nurse's office anytime, and let's finish the rest at your next proper appointment.

after5_co_tempter_seo_1.name: Seoyeon
after5_co_tempter_seo_1.text: *Seoyeon puts the rooftop keychain she'd been fidgeting with into her pocket.* Last night, the one who reached out to you first was me. That's clear.

after5_co_tempter_seo_2.name: Seoyeon
after5_co_tempter_seo_2.text: Even so, I won't be the one to hold onto you first. Not here, today.

after5_co_tempter_yuna_1.name: Yuna
after5_co_tempter_yuna_1.text: *Yuna's lock screen still shows last night's photo by the annex window.* I was the one who called you to the annex yesterday.

after5_co_tempter_yuna_2.name: Yuna
after5_co_tempter_yuna_2.text: Don't force yourself to follow anyone right now. That's enough.

after5_co_tempter_dain_1.name: Dain
after5_co_tempter_dain_1.text: *Dain presses the loose end of her knee tape flat with her palm.* I'm the one who stopped you last night and asked you to stay at the gym.

after5_co_tempter_dain_2.name: Dain
after5_co_tempter_dain_2.text: ...So today I won't be the one to call your name first.

after5_normal_start.name: {name}
after5_normal_start.text: *As the noisy festival draws to a close, in the hallway where the sunset seeps in, I meet the two people I didn't choose in the end, one after the other.*

after5_farewell_seo_high_2.name: Seoyeon
after5_farewell_seo_high_2.text: *Seoyeon's eyes catch the red sunset and glow, quiet.* I know who you chose. Still, I won't erase the past four days I liked you, as if they never happened.

after5_farewell_yuna_high_1.name: Yuna
after5_farewell_yuna_high_1.text: *Yuna writes today's date small on the back of a pale-purple bookmark and presses it into my hand.* Through the last page of this notebook... I still want you to read it.

after5_farewell_yuna_high_2.name: Yuna
after5_farewell_yuna_high_2.text: Don't be late going to the person you've set your heart on. ...Still, I'm leaving the sentences I wrote while I liked you. I won't erase them.

after5_farewell_dain_high_1.name: Dain
after5_farewell_dain_high_1.text: *Dain bounces the volleyball in her hand once on the floor, catches it, and sets it down outside the white court line without lingering.* I know the choice you made. All of it.

after5_farewell_dain_high_2.name: Dain
after5_farewell_dain_high_2.text: Still, I'm not pretending the rush I felt liking you never happened! Go and actually treat them well. If you don't, I really will get mad.

after5_hidden_teacher_high.name: Homeroom Teacher
after5_hidden_teacher_high.text: *The teacher glances over the blank comment box on the back page of critique copy 04, then closes the brown envelope.* On Monday I'll hear which sentence your breath caught on. Don't write down only the pretty words.

after5_hidden_teacher_mid.name: Homeroom Teacher
after5_hidden_teacher_mid.text: *She checks the number on the envelope of critique copy 04 by sight.* Mark honestly only as far as you actually read yourself. We'll look at the rest together during literature club.

after5_hidden_teacher_low.name: Homeroom Teacher
after5_hidden_teacher_low.text: *She tucks the manuscript envelope deep inside the file.* I'll collect the critique comments all at once at literature club, at the scheduled time. Today, let's finish the class event cleanup first.

after5_hidden_nurse_high.name: School Nurse
after5_hidden_nurse_high.text: *On the desk, she lines up the form that closes out counseling and the first-aid card in its clear case.* From now on, when a day feels too heavy, don't groan and bear it alone. Reach out first, in the order you decided today.

after5_hidden_nurse_mid.name: School Nurse
after5_hidden_nurse_mid.text: *She quietly rests a finger on the counseling QR code printed on the back of the first-aid card.* If you need to, book here anytime. You don't have to invent some big excuse about being sick.

after5_hidden_nurse_low.name: School Nurse
after5_hidden_nurse_low.text: *She slides the counseling record into the cabinet file and closes the appointment sheet.* If you need another session, apply through the school's official process. I'll close this record here.

after5_last_chance_seo_postponed.name: Seoyeon
after5_last_chance_seo_postponed.text: *Across the sunset-lit fork, Seoyeon slows, then stops when she senses me coming, and murmurs.* What we couldn't finish on the rooftop last night... today, tell me all of it.

after5_last_chance_seo_tentative.name: Seoyeon
after5_last_chance_seo_tentative.text: *Seoyeon, lingering across the fork, hears my footsteps and lets out a small breath.* Yesterday we couldn't even set our next time... and today you came to find me first.

after5_last_chance_seo_distance.name: Seoyeon
after5_last_chance_seo_distance.text: *Seoyeon, walking toward the school gate, senses me and shortens her stride.* Yesterday we clearly said we'd stop here. ...First, I'll hear why you came looking for me again today.

after5_last_chance_dain_postponed.name: Dain
after5_last_chance_dain_postponed.text: *Across the fork dyed by the sunset, Dain rolls a ball. She listens for my footsteps and speaks low.* What you couldn't finish telling me yesterday... today, don't leave any of it out.

after5_last_chance_dain_tentative.name: Dain
after5_last_chance_dain_tentative.text: *Dain, slowed across the fork, watches my shadow coming and mutters.* Yesterday we couldn't even set a next time, and today you came running first.

after5_last_chance_dain_distance.name: Dain
after5_last_chance_dain_distance.text: *Dain, walking the path in front of the gym, slows when she senses me.* Yesterday we said we'd keep our distance. ...I want to hear why you came back today.

after5_last_chance_yuna_postponed.name: Yuna
after5_last_chance_yuna_postponed.text: *Across the fork in the fading sunset, Yuna slows. She feels me coming up behind her and whispers low.* Yesterday we put off the ending of the last chapter. ...Today I'll hear what you have to say first.

after5_last_chance_yuna_tentative.name: Yuna
after5_last_chance_yuna_tentative.text: *Yuna stands across the fork, holding a book. She sees me coming and murmurs.* Yesterday I said I'd contact you first... and today you came first.

after5_last_chance_yuna_distance.name: Yuna
after5_last_chance_yuna_distance.text: *Yuna, walking quietly, shortens her stride at my footsteps.* Yesterday we clearly said we'd stop here. ...I'll hear why you came to call my name again today.

after5_hidden_return_to_park.name: {name}
after5_hidden_return_to_park.text: *I finish the last of the cleanup on campus and head to the park outside school. The festival flags that hung along the streets are folded, still, in the sunset.*

after5_farewell_seo_neg.name: Seoyeon
after5_farewell_seo_neg.text: *Seoyeon brushes past me and doesn't even turn her head.*

after5_farewell_yuna_neg.name: Yuna
after5_farewell_yuna_neg.text: *Yuna holds her book to her chest and walks off down the other end of the hall without a word.*

after5_farewell_dain_neg.name: Dain
after5_farewell_dain_neg.text: *Dain hikes her sports bag up hard and goes into the gym without looking back.*

after5_hidden_teacher_neg.name: Homeroom Teacher
after5_hidden_teacher_neg.text: *The teacher puts the manuscript envelope in the file and shuts the cover, firm.* Today we only finish the class event. Personal talk ends here.

after5_hidden_nurse_neg.name: School Nurse
after5_hidden_nurse_neg.text: *The school nurse files the counseling record and closes the appointment sheet.* From now on, apply only through the official channel. That's all for today.

after5_last_chance_seo_neg.name: Seoyeon
after5_last_chance_seo_neg.text: *Seoyeon doesn't stop. She walks out first toward the school gate.* ...Let's stop for today.

after5_last_chance_dain_neg.name: Dain
after5_last_chance_dain_neg.text: *Dain walks straight past me with the ball bag on her shoulder.* ...Don't call my name right now.

after5_last_chance_yuna_neg.name: Yuna
after5_last_chance_yuna_neg.text: *Yuna, holding her book, turns onto the other path.* ...Sorry. I'm not listening to you today.

after5_confess_react_seo_neg.name: Seoyeon
after5_confess_react_seo_neg.text: *Seoyeon slips the key ring into her pocket, her eyes gone cold.* We're not close enough to be saying that to each other right now.

after5_confess_react_dain_neg.name: Dain
after5_confess_react_dain_neg.text: *Dain picks the ball up off the floor and turns her back first.* I don't intend to hear that from your mouth. Not now.

after5_confess_react_yuna_neg.name: Yuna
after5_confess_react_yuna_neg.text: *Yuna keeps her eyes down and only turns a page of the book in her hands.* ...I'm not taking what you just said.

day5_haeun_route_choice.name: Haeun
day5_haeun_route_choice.text: Senior, if you take my hand now, it'll be hard to stay as you were with the person you already had feelings for. *Haeun folds the schedule sheet in her hands and looks up at me, eyes unsteady.* Before you answer, please think just one more time about whether you'll regret it.
choices: Go back to the person I already cared about

day5_haeun_guilt_1.name: Haeun
day5_haeun_guilt_1.text: *At the end of the hallway where the sunset seeps in, Haeun stands gripping her bag strap with both hands.* I meant it when I said I was truly cheering for you, senior. But the one who said that... I can't look Seoyeon in the face now.

day5_haeun_guilt_choice.name: Haeun
day5_haeun_guilt_choice.text: *Haeun takes a small breath and carefully lifts her head.* I'm really sorry to that person, but I also still want to stay beside you, senior, and that upsets me more. ...Is it too selfish and strange of me?
choices: What happened to all that cheering?
It's okay to be sorry and to want to stay.

day5_haeun_guilt_up.name: Haeun
day5_haeun_guilt_up.text: *The redness around Haeun's eyes softens, little by little.* ...Thank you, senior. I'll carry being sorry as it is, and from now on I won't force myself to hide how I really feel.

day5_haeun_guilt_down.name: Haeun
day5_haeun_guilt_down.text: *Haeun grips the bag strap harder, until her knuckles go white.* ...You're right. They were words I said first, myself. I'm sorry.

day5_haeun_private_1.text: Then let's talk a little more while we walk. I want to hear how you see me right now, senior. I'll... try to tell you the feelings I kept hidden, slowly.

day5_haeun_walk.text: *After we finish cleaning the student council room, we walk side by side through the streets under the sunset and reach the park. Haeun sets her bag down gently at one end of a wooden bench.* Senior, sit here. I want to hear the rest of what we couldn't finish in the hall.

day5_haeun_private_2.name: Haeun
day5_haeun_private_2.text: When we meet again after the festival, I hope we can sit side by side like this and talk. ...What kind of relationship do you want with me, senior?

day5_haeun_fallback.name: Haeun
day5_haeun_fallback.text: Thank you for hearing me all the way out today, senior. It's not that I have no feelings for you... but that person's face keeps coming back. I'm still too sorry, so I can't bring myself to say I'll take your hand and date you. Not now. *Haeun stands from the bench and shoulders her bag. She bows her head, careful, then turns back toward school alone.*

day5_ending_haeun.name: Haeun
day5_ending_haeun.text: *Haeun shifts close on the bench, into the seat right beside me, and gently takes the end of my sleeve.* I like you a lot too, senior. Let's... start dating today. Tomorrow morning, even without the excuse of student council work, can I call you out just because I want to see you?

day5_ending_haeun_apology_seoyeon.text: *Haeun smiles, bright, and glances once toward the school roof in the sunset.* I'll go see Seoyeon tomorrow, on my own, and greet her properly. I won't avoid how sorry I am. I'll carry it, and from now on I want to stand beside you, senior, with my head up.

Haeun, in the window seat, waves and moves her bag off the chair across from her.* Senior, I got here first today and saved our seats! I held off ordering so we could choose together once you got here. What should we drink today?

day5_haeun_offer_seoyeon.name: Haeun
day5_haeun_offer_seoyeon.text: Senior, weren't you about to go toward Seoyeon? What do you mean, you want to stay with me longer? Honestly, I hoped things would work out between you and Seoyeon... but that wish to cheer you on keeps wavering, and I hate myself for it.

Haeun, who followed, stops carefully half a step beside me.* Sorry. The person I want to know more deeply from now on is Haeun. I'm going with Haeun today. I wanted to say it myself, without hiding it.
